    "chunk_summary": "StatDCAT-AP describes the four DCAT-AP entities it reuses (Catalogue, Catalogue Record, Dataset, Distribution) with DCAT's definitions, then introduces its own extensions: the stat:attribute and stat:dimension properties for statistical dimensions/attributes, and the re-used dqv:hasQualityAnnotation property for quality aspects."
  },

      "anchor": "The Catalogue: represents",
      "location": "statdcat-ap-1-0-1#c0010"
    },
    {
      "id": "c2",
      "name": "Catalogue Record",
      "aliases": ["dcat:CatalogRecord"],

      "location": "statdcat-ap-1-0-1#c0010"
    },
    {
      "id": "c3",
